layout.body:
Downtown School of Data Skills
All classes meet for eight sessions from 6:00 P.M. to 7:00 P.M., beginning September 1.
Spreadsheet Introduction
Students will learn how to create spreadsheets and use functions that can speed up work. This course is good for beginners and those who need to relearn basics.
Section A: Mondays and Wednesdays
Section B: Tuesdays and Thursdays
Section C: (virtual) Wednesdays and Fridays
Formulas
Instructors will show students how to use basic spreadsheet formulas for business. Students should have basic spreadsheet skills before enrolling.
Section D: Tuesdays
Section E: (virtual) Thursdays
Data Seminar
Taught by industry professionals, this course is for researchers who want to learn how to work with complex data.
Section F: (virtual) Mondays
Data Representation
This course is for analysts and researchers who need to show audiences easy-to-read graphs and charts.
Section G: (virtual) Wednesdays

questions.analysis: Peter has no experience with spreadsheets and cannot attend class on Wednesdays. He should enroll in 原文依据： Spreadsheet Introduction. Students will learn how to create spreadsheets and use functions that can speed up work. This course is good for beginners and those who need to relearn basics. Section A: Mondays and Wednesdays; Section B: Tuesdays and Thursdays; Section C: (virtual) Wednesdays and Fridays. 翻译： 电子表格入门。学生将学习如何创建电子表格以及使用能提高工作效率的函数。本课程适合初学者和需要重新学习基础知识的人。A 班：周一和周三；B 班：周二和周四；C 班：（线上）周三和周五。 选项分析： (A) Section A A 班 → 错误（A 班在周三上课，Peter 无法参加） (B) Section B B 班 → 正确（电子表格入门适合无经验的 Peter，且 B 班在周二和周四上课，不涉及周三） (C) Section C C 班 → 错误（C 班在周三上课，Peter 无法参加） (D) Section D D 班 → 错误（D 班是公式课程，要求有基础电子表格技能，Peter 无经验，不符合要求）

questions.stem: What does Michelle need before enrolling in Section D?

options.B: A research position that requires creating formulas
options.C: Training in how to present complex data

questions.analysis: What does Michelle need before enrolling in Section D? 原文依据： Formulas. Instructors will show students how to use basic spreadsheet formulas for business. Students should have basic spreadsheet skills before enrolling. Section D: Tuesdays. 翻译： 公式课程。讲师将向学生展示如何使用用于商业的基础电子表格公式。学生在注册前应具备基础的电子表格技能。D 班：周二。 选项分析： (A) Experience creating new spreadsheet formulas 有创建新电子表格公式的经验 → 错误（课程是教授基础公式，无需已有创建公式的经验） (B) A research position that requires creating formulas 有需要创建公式的研究职位 → 错误（原文未提及需要相关职位） (C) Training in how to present complex data 有展示复杂数据的培训经历 → 错误（与公式课程的前置要求无关） (D) Previous experience using spreadsheets 有使用电子表格的过往经验 → 正确（原文明确要求注册前需具备基础电子表格技能）

questions.analysis: Beth has worked with formulas for years and is ready to learn advanced data skills. She should enroll in 原文依据： Formulas. Students should have basic spreadsheet skills before enrolling. Data Seminar. Taught by industry professionals, this course is for researchers who want to learn how to work with complex data. Section F: (virtual) Mondays. Data Representation. This course is for analysts and researchers who need to show audiences easy-to-read graphs and charts. 翻译： 公式课程。学生在注册前应具备基础电子表格技能。数据研讨会。由行业专业人士授课，本课程面向希望学习如何处理复杂数据的研究人员。F 班：（线上）周一。数据呈现。本课程面向需要向观众展示易读图表的分析师和研究人员。 选项分析： (A) Section A, B, or C A 班、B 班或 C 班 → 错误（这些是电子表格入门课程，Beth 已有多年公式使用经验，无需学习基础内容） (B) Section D or E D 班或 E 班 → 错误（这些是公式课程，Beth 已熟练使用公式，无需再学） (C) Section F F 班 → 正确（F 班是数据研讨会，教授处理复杂数据的技能，属于高级数据技能，符合 Beth 的需求） (D) Section G G 班 → 错误（G 班是数据呈现课程，侧重图表展示，并非 Beth 需要的高级数据处理技能）
